name: GTA 6 pre-load shows "not available" or "coming soon"
symptom: The store page shows the game but there is no Download / Pre-load button.

name: GTA 6 pre-order not showing in my library
symptom: You paid for a pre-order but the game is nowhere in Your Collection or Library.

name: GTA 6 licence or entitlement error at launch
symptom: The game refuses to start and reports that no licence was found for this account.

name: Not enough storage to install GTA 6
symptom: The console blocks the download and says there is not enough free space.

name: GTA 6 download stuck, paused or at 0%
symptom: The queue shows GTA 6 but the percentage never moves, or it silently pauses.

name: The code inside the GTA 6 box will not redeem
symptom: You bought a physical copy, entered the code, and the store rejects it.

name: GTA 6 download failed in the Rockstar Launcher
platform: PC (only if a PC version is announced)
symptom: A PC download stalls or fails in the launcher.

name: GTA 6 DirectX error on startup
platform: PC (only if a PC version is announced)
symptom: The game crashes to desktop with a DirectX device error.

name: GTA 6 won't launch
symptom: You select the game, it appears to start, then nothing happens.

name: GTA 6 black screen on startup
platform: PC (only if a PC version is announced)
symptom: Audio runs but the display stays black.
